# cork-collapse

A box with a title bar that shows and hides its content.

To alter the color of the title bar, add a category brand class to the element, e.g. class="category-brand--rec-pool".
This requires the theme's global stylesheet for brand classes be loaded.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `Boolean` | Whether the content is shown. Starting open shows it without animating. Later changes, from a title click or from code, slide it open or closed. Attribute: open (reflected). |

## Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | The title and the content. The title is derived from the first h1-h6 child. All heading levels are styled the same. You can use a div/span with the data-heading attribute instead of a heading element. See [`HeadingController`](../utils/controllers/HeadingController.md). Everything else is the content, and keeps the page's styles. |

## Events

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cork-collapse-toggle` | Fired when a title click toggles open. Not fired when open is set from code. detail.open: whether it's now open. Bubbles and is composed. |

## Methods

### get contentEle

The shadow DOM element that wraps the content slot, and slides open and closed.

**Returns:** `HTMLElement\|null`

## Examples

**Import**

```js
import '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-collapse';

// or the class only, without registering the element:
import CorkCollapse from '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-collapse/cork-collapse.js';
```

**Heading**

```html
<cork-collapse>
  <h3>How do I renew a book?</h3>
  <p>Sign in to your <a href="/account">library account</a> and choose Renew.</p>
  <p>Or call the library at 555-555-5555.</p>
</cork-collapse>
```

**No heading element**

```html
<cork-collapse>
  <div data-heading>More details</div>
  <p>Supplementary details.</p>
</cork-collapse>
```

**Open**

```html
<cork-collapse open>
  <h3>Hours</h3>
  <p>Open 24 hours during finals.</p>
</cork-collapse>
```

**Brand color**

```html
<cork-collapse class="category-brand--rec-pool">
  <h3>Recreation</h3>
  <p>Content.</p>
</cork-collapse>
```

**Listening for toggles**

```js
collapse.addEventListener('cork-collapse-toggle', e => {
  console.log(e.detail.open);
});
```
